newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN THE ITALIAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN THE ITALIAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: The following matches are scheduled to take place this weekend in the Italian League championship:
(League positions in parentheses, all matches on Sunday, all kickoff times GMT)
Juventus (5) V Inter-Milan (1) 1830

Angelo Peruzzi and Frenchman Zinedine Zidane return for Juventus against the multinational Inter, missing suspended English midfielder Paul Ince and likely to field an Italian attack of Marco Branca and Maurizio Ganz.
Bologna (4) V Fiorentina (12) 1330

With Francesco Baiano suspended, Fiorentina will again look to their Latin America strike force of Argentine Gabriel Batistuta and Brazilian Oliveira against an in-form Bologna side which features a powerul attacking trio in Russian Igor Kolyvanov, Swede Kennet Andersson and Davide Fontolan.
Lazio (13) v Cagliari (15) 1330

Lazio defenders Alessandro Grandoni, Alessandro Nesta, Italo-Australian Paul Okon and Argentine Jose Chamot are ruled out, making way for South African Mark Fish against a cautious Cagliari side likely to field only Giacomo Banchelli in attack.
AC Milan (6) v Napoli (9) 1330

Will Milan recall Roberto Baggio? After successive defeats by AS Roma and IFK Gothenburg, Milan badly need a boost but will be without Dutchman Edgar Davids, Yugoslavian Dejan Savicevic and Tomas Locatelli, all injured, against a Napoli side reliant on its Brazilian trio of Andre Cruz, Beto and Caio.
Parma (3) V Perugia (11) 1330

Gianfranco Zola and Enrico Chiesa lead a Parma side keen to atone for its early dual elimination from the Italian and UEFA Cups. Perugia coach Giovanni Galeone, who had to have a midweek heart check-up, gets out of hospital to face the strain.
Piacenza (14) v Reggiana (16) 1330
Early season relegation scrap in which Reggiana look to Colombian Alfredo Valencia and Sandro Tovalieri to pick up away points against the all-Italian Piacenza.
Sampdoria (10) v Atalanta (17) 1330
Inconsistent so far this season, Sampdoria will be without suspended Frenchman Christian Karembeu but will want home points against an Atalanta side led by ex-Milan wonder boy Gigi Lentini.
Udinese (8) v Vicenza (7) 1330

Injury hit Udinese will be without German striker Oliver Bierhoff, defenders Giovanni Bia and Pole Marek Kozminski and midfielder Giovanni Stroppa against in form Vicenza, led by Uruguyan Marcelo Otero, joint leading goalscorer with Atalanta's Filippo Inzaghi and Milan's George Weah, all on five goals.
Verona (18) v AS Roma (2) 1330

Roma, beaten 3-0 by German side Karlsruhe in a midweek UEFA Cup tie, recall Argentine Abel Balbo and Francesco Totti to the attack while Swede Jonas Thern, Francesco Statuto, Francesco Moriero and Antonino Bernardini all return to midfield following injuries. Verona look to Antonio Di Vitis and Filippo Maniero in attack.
